cs.t: I've gone through quite a few embedded devices for exactly this use case.  So far I've used: - Soekris net4501 (x86, 486-class CPU) (discontinued) - PCEngines alix2d3 (x86, AMD Geode LX800) (discontinued) - PCEngines APU (x86, AMD T40E) (my current router/firewall) (discontinued) The next system I plan to use is going to be a BananaPi R4 (ARM Cortex A73), it's a solid choice for a simple router/firewall/DNS/DHCP box.  It has a built-in 4-port gigabit switch where each interface can be used as normal Linux interfaces, as well as 2 SFP+ ports that are capable of supporting up to 10 gig ethernet. It's also one of the few systems that offers true hardware offloading for connection tracking, so things like netfilter flowtables don't have to use any main CPU processing.
cs.th: How to Turn Anything into a Router
